label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: Nothing is simultaneously in act and in POTENCY_1 in…
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., prima via: Non autem est possibile ut idem sit simul in actu et potentia secundum idem
interpretation: A non-contradiction principle for act and potency indexed to one respect at one time. The hot thing is at once cold in potency, so different respects are explicitly allowed.
